name: PSL tier: Chadlite

card.summary: Chadlite is the PSL tier just below Chad, a benchmark of very high facial attractiveness that members use to set goals for how far looksmaxxing can take them.
card.note: A community rating framework, not a scientific measure; it can feed appearance anxiety.

quick.overview:
Chadlite is one of the tiers of the PSL (Perceived Sexual Levels) scale used on looksmaxxing forums. It sits just below Chad and above high-tier normie, and describes a man seen as strikingly good-looking.

The tier works as a target. Members compare their features to the tier, ask whether a given face will reach it after growth or after procedures, and use it to decide which improvements to pursue, such as eyebrows, skin, jaw or body.
quick.how: On looksmax.org, users post photos or descriptions and ask for a rating, sometimes with qualifiers such as low, mid or high within a tier. Discussion focuses on features like eye area, jaw, maxilla and facial harmony, and on fixable items such as brows and angles.
quick.risks: The scale is an informal peer rating and not a validated measure. Critics quoted in media describe it as pseudoscientific, tied to incel ideology and potentially harmful to mental health, and a tier label can become a source of distress.

lead: Chadlite is a tier in the PSL scale, one of seven categories from sub-3 to giga Chad: subhuman, low, mid and high-tier normie, Chadlite, Chad and giga Chad [7]. The scale rates facial attractiveness and was created in the 2010s on forums including PUAHate, Sluthate and Lookism.net [7].

Chadlite is the tier immediately below Chad. Users use it to describe a man whose looks stand out but who falls short of the top category; members debate what percentile this represents, with one thread titled as arguing chadlite is not 97th percentile [2][3].

In practice the term is used in rating threads and aspirational questions, such as whether a friend with strong eyes but a slightly recessed mandible might reach it [4]. Members also use it when discussing dating outcomes and when asking about plastic surgery [5][6].

chain: Compare face and features against the PSL tiers
Identify weak features (brows, jaw, skin, angles)
Target those with looksmaxxing methods to move up a tier
angle.text: The tier gives people a concrete goal for facial improvement. Members use rating feedback to decide what to change, such as eyebrow shape or camera angle.

paras: PSL ranks faces on roughly a 1 to 8 range and is meant to reflect how women perceive men [7]. Chadlite is the sixth of seven named tiers [7].
The scale originated on incel-adjacent forums in the 2010s and spread to TikTok in the early 2020s, with media coverage from Vice in 2023 and outlets such as the BBC and the Guardian in 2024 [7].

Threads ask members to rate faces as chadlite or lower, discuss which traits qualify, and mention a person's potential to reach the tier [3][4]. Members suggest fixing eyebrows and photo angle after reviewing a rating request [3]. Some threads connect the tier to dating, with comments on how women respond to chadlites [5].
Critics cited in coverage describe the PSL system as pseudoscientific and tied to incel ideology, and note potential harm to mental health [7].

timeline.event: PSL scale created on PUAHate, Sluthate and Lookism.net [7].
Vice covers hunter eyes; wider media coverage of looksmaxxing follows [7].

lore.intro: Rating threads treat Chadlite as a benchmark for high attractiveness [3][4].

claims.claim: Chadlite is a distinct, definable attractiveness tier
claims.believers: Members post descriptions and photos asking whether a face qualifies and argue over what percentile it represents [3][4][2].
claims.experts: Critics say the PSL framework is pseudoscientific [7].
